lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: COLLEGE YEAR 3! Junior year — ang tinaguriang 'Hell Year' sa {course}. May Thesis Proposal, heavy practicum prep, at kaliwa't kanang fees.
lines.textEn: COLLEGE YEAR 3! Junior year — famously called 'Hell Year' in {course}. Thesis proposals, heavy major labs, and nonstop fees.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Kailangan na natin bumuo ng Thesis Group ngayong linggo, {name}! Sabay-sabay tayo nina Miggy at Jamie para walang freeloader!
lines.textEn: We need to lock in our Thesis Group this week, {name}! Let us team up with Miggy and Jamie so there are zero freeloaders!

choices.text: Bumuo ng dream Thesis Team kasama ang barkada!
choices.textEn: Form the dream Thesis Team with your barkada!

journal.title: Junior Year & Thesis Group
journal.summary: Nagsimula ang 3rd year at binuo mo ang Thesis Team kasama ang mga pinagkakatiwalaan mong kaibigan.
journal.summaryEn: Entered 3rd year and assembled your trusted Thesis Team.

choices.text: Mag-solo / small-pair thesis kay Bea para mas kontrolado ang oras ng trabaho.
choices.textEn: Pair up tightly with Bea to keep work shifts flexible.

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Title Defense! Ilatag ninyo ang tatlong thesis proposals ninyo. Tandaan: kailangan realistic sa budget ng estudyante, hindi puro drawing!
lines.textEn: Title Defense! Pitch your three thesis proposals. Remember: keep it realistic for a student budget, not sci-fi fantasy!

choices.text: I-pitch ang community-focused {course} study na swak sa budget!
choices.textEn: Pitch a practical, community-focused {course} study that fits your budget!

choices.text: I-pitch ang ambitious tech/research innovation (-₱350 prototype materials).
choices.textEn: Pitch an ambitious innovation study (-₱350 initial materials).

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Sabay-sabay dumating ang tuition balance, thesis printing, at hospital bill sa bahay. Biglang nag-message ang manager mo sa part-time work.
lines.textEn: Tuition balance, thesis printing, and a family clinic bill all hit in the same week. Suddenly your part-time manager sends an offer.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.text: {name}, nag-resign ang assistant supervisor namin. Kung mag-full time ka ngayon, ₱18,000/month agad ang sahod mo — pero kailangan mong mag-stop muna sa school.
lines.textEn: {name}, our assistant supervisor resigned. If you go full-time now, you get ₱18,000/month immediately — but you would have to pause school.

choices.text: 'Salamat po, pero tatapusin ko ang {course} ko! Part-time lang muna.' (-₱1,600 tuition)
choices.textEn: 'Thank you, but I am finishing {course}! Keeping it part-time.' (-₱1,600 tuition)

choices.text: Tanggapin ang full-time offer para makabayad ng utang at tulungan si Mama.
choices.textEn: Accept the full-time job to pay off debts and lift Mama up.

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: HELL WEEK! Tatlong major exams, dalawang case study, at isang lab demo sa loob ng apat na araw! Nakakadalawang kape na ako at nanginginig na kamay ko!
lines.textEn: HELL WEEK! Three major exams, two case studies, and a lab demo in four days! On my second coffee and my hands are vibrating!

choices.text: Mag-divide and conquer kasama ang barkada — tulungan sa reviewers!
choices.textEn: Divide and conquer reviewers with the barkada!

choices.text: Uminom ng tubig, matulog ng 6 hours, at unahin ang pinakamalaking exam.
choices.textEn: Drink water, get 6 real hours of sleep, and prioritize the biggest exam.

lines.speaker: Carlo
lines.text: University Week fair! May bakanteng booth slot — kung magtutulungan tayo magbenta ng iced coffee, tusok-tusok, at org merch, malaking kita 'to pambayad ng tuition!
lines.textEn: University Week fair! There is an open booth slot — if we sell iced coffee, street snacks, and merch, we can make serious tuition money!

choices.textEn: Launch the student fair booth! (Play Street Snacks)

choices.text: Magbayad na lang ng tuition directly (-₱1,500) at mag-review.
choices.textEn: Skip the booth, settle tuition (-₱1,500), and keep studying.

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: 4TH YEAR NA TAYO NEXT SEM, {name}! Graduating status na! Parang kailan lang nag-aagawan pa tayo ng barya sa jeep!
lines.textEn: WE ARE SENIORS NEXT TERM, {name}! Graduating status! Feels like yesterday we were counting coins in the jeepney!

choices.text: Huling taon na — ilaban natin hanggang PICC / Graduation Stage!
choices.textEn: One final year — let us fight all the way to the Graduation Stage!

journal.title: Graduating Status!
journal.summary: Nalampasan mo ang 3rd Year Hell Year! Isang taon na lang — Thesis, OJT, at Graduation na!
journal.summaryEn: Conquered Junior Hell Year! One final year — Thesis, OJT, and Graduation!

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Maghanda na kayo ng resume at endorsement letter para sa 4th Year OJT/Practicum! May partner companies na nagbibigay ng allowance sa top applicants.
lines.textEn: Prepare your resume and endorsement letters for 4th Year OJT! Several partner sites pay real allowances to strong applicants.

choices.text: Ayusin nang pulido ang resume at portfolio ngayon!
choices.textEn: Polish your resume and portfolio right away!

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Ang daming freshies na nagpapaturo sa major subjects! Gusto mo bang mag-review session tayo — ₱100 per head sa 6 students?
lines.textEn: Tons of freshmen want tutoring in our major! Want to host a mini review session — ₱100 per head?

choices.textEn: Count me in! Let us tutor! (Play Tutoring Quiz)

choices.text: Pass muna — kailangan ko ng tulog.
choices.textEn: Pass for now — I need sleep.
